note: Sound descriptions for the 37 events src/audio/sfx.js already names. Written in the SFX style the model expects: source, material, space, temporal evolution, and a final 'Length: N seconds' that must agree with the graph's duration input. Sent verbatim (the reprompt chain is removed from the graph), so a description can be reviewed, replayed and improved. Category drives which envelope gate the clip has to pass.
space: dry close perspective inside a stone dungeon corridor, short natural room reverb, no music, no dialogue

swing_whoosh.prompt: A sword blade whooshing through air: fast metallic swish with a slight resonant ring, sharp attack, quick decay

hit_metal.prompt: Sword striking an iron shield: hard metallic clang with bright ringing overtones and a short dull thud underneath

hit_flesh.prompt: Blade landing on a padded heavy body: dense wet thud with a short leather crack, no squelch

hit_slime.prompt: Blade striking a taut gelatinous mass: deep elastic slap with a rubbery rebound and wet resonance

bow_draw.prompt: A wooden bow being drawn: creaking limbs, stretching string, leather glove friction, rising tension

bow_release.prompt: Bowstring released: sharp twang with a wooden limb slap and a short air whoosh

bow_empty.prompt: Bowstring released with no arrow: dry thin click and slapping string against an empty hand

weapon_swap.prompt: A weapon changing hands: brief cloth and leather rustle with a light metallic clink

arrow_impact.prompt: Arrow striking a wooden crate: sharp wooden thunk with a brief high vibration of the shaft

fireball_cast.prompt: A burst of flame thrown from a hand: immediate rushing whoosh with crackling fire from the first instant, medium loudness

fireball_impact.prompt: Fireball detonating against a wall: deep percussive boom with bursting flame and crumbling debris

magic_orb_cast.prompt: A glowing arcane orb forming: shimmering tonal rising tone with soft crystalline shimmer and airy shimmer

ghost_moan.prompt: A spectral moan: breathy wavering voice-like tone sliding downward, hollow and distant, sustaining through the whole clip with a short reverb tail

ghost_hit.prompt: Blade passing through a spectral body: cold airy whoosh with a brief dissonant shimmer

slime_squelch.prompt: A large gelatinous creature oozing across wet stone: thick slow squelching and bubbling

orc_grunt.prompt: A large humanoid creature's short aggressive grunt: guttural low growl, non-verbal, brief

orc_death.prompt: A large humanoid creature's death cry: long guttural groan falling in pitch, ending in a heavy body thud

archer_call.prompt: A goblin archer's sharp warning bark: short high rasping shout, non-verbal, aggressive

boss_roar.prompt: A huge creature's roar: deep bellowing growl with gravelly rasp and rumbling chest resonance, filling the room

pickup_gear.prompt: Picking up a piece of gear from stone: bright metallic clink with a short ring

equip_upgrade.prompt: Equipping a better weapon: metallic slide into a scabbard followed by a bright resonant chime

salvage.prompt: Smashing salvage into coins: short bright metallic scatter of small change

heal.prompt: Drinking a healing potion: glassy pour, soft liquid glug, brief warm shimmering tone

extra_life.prompt: A magical relic restoring a life: bright ascending bell chime with radiant shimmer and a soft boom

armor_break.prompt: Plate armour breaking apart: sharp metallic snapping with grinding rivets and falling plates

player_hurt.prompt: A wounded human grunt of pain: short breathy exhale with a dull body impact

player_death.prompt: A dying breath and a collapse: falling exhale, then a heavy limp body hitting stone

stairs_start.prompt: Descending a stone stair: slow heavy footsteps echoing down a deep shaft, pitch falling as distance grows

stairs_complete.prompt: Arriving at the bottom of a stair: heavy stone footfall into a vast empty chamber with a long dark reverb tail

menu_click.prompt: A small mechanical UI click: tight dry click with a faint metallic edge, very short

menu_back.prompt: A small UI cancel tone: short dry click descending slightly in pitch

level_start.prompt: A low ominous drone rising into a cavernous stone hall, distant torch crackle and settling dust, deep sub-bass swell

distant_drip.prompt: A single water drop falling into a distant pool: small clear plink with long faint echo

distant_skitter.prompt: Many small legs skittering quickly across gravel far away: light dry chittering rustle

distant_stone.prompt: Stone grinding deep in the dark: long low tectonic rumble with occasional rockfalls echoing
